title: Summoning Ninjas & Playing Hidden Cards
subtitle: Face-up, face-down, revealed or upgraded: four ways to put a ninja to work.
summary: Learn every way to play a character: pay full cost face-up for its MAIN effects, slip one in hidden for 1 Chakra, reveal it later to spring an AMBUSH, or upgrade a same-name ninja for the difference.

steps.title: One card, then it's their turn
steps.body: The [[Action phase]] is a back-and-forth. The [[Edge token]] holder goes first, then players alternate, and on your turn you do exactly one thing: play one card, or [[pass]]. Once you pass you're out of the Action phase until next Round. If your opponent has already passed, you keep taking turns one after another until you pass too.

steps.title: Summon face-up
steps.body: The straightforward play: put a character from your hand face-up onto a mission and pay its printed Chakra cost. Its [[MAIN]] effects resolve right away. Naruto here pays 2, then his MAIN [[POWERUP]] 1 adds a [[Power token]], for 3 Power. Watch the name rule: each side of a mission can hold only **one character with a given name**.

callout.text: One character per name, per mission, on each side. A second Naruto must go to another mission, or upgrade the first.

steps.title: Slip in hidden
steps.body: Any character can be played **face-down** to a mission for a flat **1 Chakra**, whatever its printed cost. While [[hidden]] it has **0 Power** and no active effects, but it is still a character: it adds 1 Chakra in your next [[Start phase]] and can carry [[Power tokens]]. Your opponent sees only a mystery card, and has to respect what it might be.

steps.title: Reveal: spring the AMBUSH
steps.body: On a later turn you can [[reveal]] a hidden character by paying its **printed cost**. It flips face-up and you apply its [[MAIN]] effects **and** its [[AMBUSH]] effects. Revealing counts as playing a character. Kakashi costs 1 to hide and 4 to reveal, 5 in total, and his ambush [[POWERUP]] 2 turns a 3-Power ninja into a 5-Power surprise.

callout.text: AMBUSH never fires when you play the card face-up straight from your hand. It has to start hidden.

steps.title: Upgrade a ninja
steps.body: You can't put two same-name characters on your side of one mission, but you can [[upgrading|upgrade]]: play a same-name character with a **strictly higher cost** on top of the one in play and pay only the difference. The new card's [[MAIN]] and [[UPGRADE]] effects resolve, any [[Power tokens]] stay on the stack, and the stack still counts as a single character.

callout.text: Same cost or lower isn't allowed. Naruto, Sage Mode (5) over Naruto, Genin (2) costs 5 − 2 = 3 Chakra.

steps.title: Which play, and when?
steps.body: Face-up gives you full Power and the MAIN effect now, but shows your hand. Hidden is cheap, works as a bluff and saves the [[AMBUSH]] for later, at the price of 0 Power until revealed. Upgrading turns an early, cheap ninja into a late powerhouse at a discount. Strong turns mix all three, and before you pass, count how much your opponent could still reveal.
bullets: Hidden: 1 Chakra, a bluff, AMBUSH later
Upgrade: pay the difference, keep the tokens

widget.title: Hidden Card Simulator
widget.brief: Play Kakashi Hatake [[hidden]] for 1 Chakra. On your next turn, click the face-down card and pay his printed 4 Chakra to reveal him. His [[AMBUSH]] fires POWERUP 2, which is enough to win the mission.

quiz.prompt: You play Zabuza Momochi (printed cost 4) face-down. How much Chakra do you pay?
quiz.explanation: A [[hidden]] play always costs **1 Chakra**, whatever the printed cost. You pay the printed 4 only if you reveal him later.

quiz.prompt: You play Kakashi Hatake face-up straight from your hand. Does his AMBUSH: POWERUP 2 fire?
choices: Yes, AMBUSH fires whenever he enters play
No, AMBUSH fires only when he's revealed from hidden
Only if he's the first character you play this Round
Only if your opponent has already passed
quiz.explanation: [[AMBUSH]] fires only when you reveal a hidden character. Played face-up from hand, only his [[MAIN]] effects (he has none) would resolve.

quiz.prompt: Naruto Uzumaki, Genin (cost 2) is in play. You upgrade him into Naruto Uzumaki, Sage Mode (cost 5). What do you pay, and what fires?
choices: 0 Chakra; his Power tokens are removed
quiz.explanation: When [[upgrading]] you pay the difference (5 − 2 = 3) and resolve the new card's [[MAIN]] and [[UPGRADE]] effects. Power tokens stay on the stack.
